business_summary: Black Peony (Group) Co., Ltd. engages in the new urbanization construction, and textiles and clothing business in China. The company is involved in infrastructure, building, and housing construction; real estate development; property services; industrial park development; construction, operation, and commercial services of technology parks; and renovation and operation of cultural and creative parks, as well as exploration and promotion of projects. It also engages in dyeing, weaving, finishing, and manufacturing garments; and research, development, production, and sale of textiles and clothing. Black Peony (Group) Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is based in Changzhou City, China.
